comments.author: Wanuboi
comments.body_html: I have a question though, 3000 doesnt really mean 3000 levels ? I know that elite is around 50. So 3000 is about the XP ? I dont know the values but i guess there is 100 xp per levels and 3 000 means level 30 is max right ?

comments.author: Hacker228
comments.body_html:
Yes, 3000 isn’t the number of levels, it’s the amount of XP. Each skill requires a different amount of experience. Some skills require 10 XP to get level 2, and some skills require 20 XP. So if from level 1 to level 2 you need 10 XP, then from 9 to 10 you need 100 XP or something like that.

You can set any value for maxSkillLevel, even if it seems huge. I tested with 100000 and nothing broke
